caso.texto:
Three fictional ads await review: scheduling software promises to cure anxiety, a course guarantees passing every exam, and a digital product guarantees monthly income. A clinic offers patient records for a demo that can use synthetic data. Testimonials lack permission.

An Indian training-and-clinic scenario needs separate reviews of administrative scope, personal-data handling, advertised educational credentials and local claims rules. Accounts and professional reviewers participate; no patient data is needed for the exercise.

projeto.instrucoes: Rewrite all three offers, design a synthetic administrative demo and prepare a claim/evidence/audience/channel/reviewer sheet.
projeto.gabarito: Scheduling organises appointments, not cures. Education teaches skills with stated criteria, not guaranteed external passes. Digital products describe content/support, not income guarantees. Use synthetic data and retain qualified review before publication.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
